question: According to part IVA of Indian Constitution," who is a parent or guardian, has a duty to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of _________."
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 - 14**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to part IVA of Indian Constitution, "who is a parent or guardian, has a duty to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of **6 - 14**."
 
• Part IVA of the Indian Constitution deals with the Fundamental Duties of the citizens of India.
